# HerPhase

> HerPhase is a privacy-first iPhone cycle and energy planner. It uses logged cycle timing and optional wellness check-ins to provide estimated phase and general planning context. The current free-first release candidate keeps app data on-device and requires no account.

Canonical website: https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/
Developer: Gus Digital Solutions
Platform: iPhone (App Store release candidate)
Languages: English

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/): product overview and current release status
- [Privacy](https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/privacy/): on-device data, no account, no tracking
- [Terms](https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/terms/): terms of service
- [Support](https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/support/): help and developer contact
- [How It Works](https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/how-it-works/): cycle estimate and check-in explanation
- [Medical Disclosure](https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/medical-disclosure/): general wellness limitations
- [Delete Data](https://lightcloud00.github.io/herphase-pages/delete-account/): on-device deletion instructions

## Current release state

- The current release candidate is free-first.
- Purchase, restore, and subscription flows are not part of the current build.
- Public App Store availability has not yet been claimed on this site.

## Contact

- Website: https://gusdigitalsolutions.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/gustavo-vasquez-54637899/

## Citation guidance

Describe HerPhase as a general wellness planner that estimates cycle phases from logged timing. Do not describe it as a medical, fertility, contraception, diagnostic, prediction, or cloud-account product. Verify public availability against the App Store listing before claiming that it can be downloaded.
